subject: Use of English
text: Choose the word that is NEAREST in meaning to the word: enormous.
explanation: ‘Enormous’ means very large in size or quantity, so ‘huge’ is the closest synonym.

subject: Physics
text: The SI unit of force is the:
explanation: Force is measured in newtons (N). The joule is energy, the watt is power, and the pascal is pressure.

subject: Chemistry
text: The chemical symbol for sodium is:
explanation: Sodium's symbol is Na, from its Latin name ‘natrium’. Sn is tin and S is sulphur.

subject: Biology
text: Which cell organelle is known as the ‘powerhouse of the cell’?
explanation: The mitochondrion releases energy (ATP) through respiration, so it is called the powerhouse of the cell.
